verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a dedicated security page. It documents on-site shredding of unwanted mail with destruction certificates, 2FA for account access, a HIPAA BAA, and an option to have mail shipped unopened and unscanned. However, none of the three elements the story names (facility controls, staff screening, encryption of scans) is documented. Missing for 10: facility physical access controls, staff background screening, encryption of scanned mail at rest/in transit, independent audits or certifications, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, the provider documents how mail is physically secured and digitally protected — facility controls, staff screening, encryption of scans

citations.quote: All of your unwanted mail is shredded on-site using mobile shredding services... Document destruction certificates are available upon request.
This extra layer of authentication strengthens security access to your account and data.
VPM will also sign a BAA to satisfy HIPAA requirements.
you can request that your mail not be opened or scanned, and instead, have it shipped to directly to you.
